introduction.heading: 1. Introduction
introduction.body: ORBCAST is a non-custodial software interface ("the Interface") operated by LUNATIC WISDOM LABS LLC ("the Company," "we," "our"), a Wyoming limited liability company. We provide a graphical window to trade Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets (including sports and other event contracts). This policy explains how we handle your data.

informationWeCollect.heading: 2. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.walletData: • Wallet Data: We interact with your public wallet address and on-chain transaction history via Hyperliquid L1. We do NOT collect or store your private keys.
informationWeCollect.authenticationData: • Authentication Data: If you use email or social login, this is managed by our partner, Privy. We only receive a unique identifier/email to manage your session.
informationWeCollect.deviceData: • Device & Location Data: We collect your IP address for geofencing compliance (trading restrictions) and basic device info (OS, browser type) for performance.
informationWeCollect.usageData: • Usage Data: Anonymous information on Interface interactions (e.g., page views) to help us improve the software experience.

howWeUseInformation.heading: 3. How We Use Information
howWeUseInformation.provideMaintainImprove: • Maintenance: To keep the Interface functional and resolve technical bugs.
howWeUseInformation.geofencingCompliance: • Compliance: To enforce regional restrictions and geofencing as required by our Terms of Service.
howWeUseInformation.legalSecurity: • Security: To detect fraudulent activity or potential exploits and comply with our legal obligations in Wyoming.
howWeUseInformation.communication: • Communication: To provide support and respond to inquiries sent to our help desk.

howWeShareInformation.heading: 4. How We Share Information
howWeShareInformation.serviceProviders: • We share data with infrastructure providers (e.g., hosting, RPC nodes) necessary to run the Interface.
howWeShareInformation.authenticationPartners: • Privy: Your login data is managed by Privy under their privacy policy.
howWeShareInformation.paymentProcessors: • MoonPay: If you use the fiat on-ramp, MoonPay collects your KYC data independently. We do not store your government ID or bank details for that flow.
howWeShareInformation.lawEnforcement: • Law Enforcement: We may disclose information if required by a valid court order or to comply with Wyoming or US Federal law.

dataRetentionDeletion.heading: 5. Data Retention & Deletion
dataRetentionDeletion.accountDeletion: • Account Deletion: You can request to delete your Interface profile. We will scrub your email and usage logs from our internal systems.
dataRetentionDeletion.blockchainException: • Blockchain Exception: We cannot delete your data from Hyperliquid L1 or Arbitrum. On-chain data is permanent and beyond the control of the Company.

userControlWalletOwnership.heading: 6. User Control & Wallet Ownership
userControlWalletOwnership.noAccess: • Trading Wallet: You retain control of your self-custody trading wallet. The Company has no technical means to access your private keys, reverse on-chain trades, or recover lost seed phrases.

dataSecurity.heading: 7. Data Security
dataSecurity.intro: We use industry-standard encryption to protect data in transit, but you are the primary guardian of your security:
dataSecurity.secureWallet: • You are solely responsible for protecting your private keys and device access.
dataSecurity.noRecovery: • We cannot recover lost funds or compromised wallets.

updatesToPolicy.heading: 8. Updates to This Policy
updatesToPolicy.body: We may update this policy to reflect changes in regulation. Continued use of the Interface after an update constitutes acceptance.

contactUs.heading: 9. Contact Us
contactUs.body: For questions or legal inquiries, please contact us at:

acceptanceOfTerms.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptanceOfTerms.body: By accessing or using ORBCAST ("the Interface"), you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the Interface.
acceptanceOfTerms.operatorDisclosure: ORBCAST is a software interface operated by LUNATIC WISDOM LABS LLC ("the Company"), a Wyoming limited liability company.

restrictedJurisdictions.heading: 1.1 Restricted Jurisdictions & U.S. Persons
restrictedJurisdictions.body: ORBCAST strictly prohibits use by "U.S. Persons" (as defined in Regulation S under the U.S. Securities Act of 1934) and residents of Restricted Jurisdictions.
restrictedJurisdictions.prohibitedJurisdictions: • Prohibited Jurisdictions: United States, United Kingdom, North Korea, Iran, and any jurisdiction subject to OFAC sanctions.
restrictedJurisdictions.representation: • Representation: By using the Interface, you represent and warrant that you are NOT a resident, citizen, or located in any of these territories, and you are not using a VPN, proxy, or other technology to bypass these restrictions.
restrictedJurisdictions.enforcement: • Enforcement: We reserve the right to implement technical geofencing and terminate access to anyone found violating these regional restrictions.

descriptionOfService.heading: 2. Description of Service
descriptionOfService.body: ORBCAST is a non-custodial software interface for Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets (event contracts such as sports Yes/No and multi-outcome questions). The Interface does not execute trades, provide liquidity, or hold your funds. It lets you view books and send orders you sign with your wallet.
descriptionOfService.outcomeMarkets: • Outcome Markets: Fully collateralized prediction contracts on Hyperliquid L1. There is no leverage and no perpetual-futures product in this Interface.
descriptionOfService.finalBody: All trades and settlements are executed on-chain via Hyperliquid. ORBCAST is a software interface provider and is NOT a broker, financial advisor, or intermediary. We do not have access to, or custody of, your private keys or funds.

nonCustodialNature.heading: 3. Non-Custodial Nature & User Responsibility
nonCustodialNature.noCustody: • No Custody: ORBCAST does not hold, custody, or control user funds, wallets, or trading positions at any time.
nonCustodialNature.walletManagement: • Wallet Management: You can use our free embedded wallet service created via Privy. You are solely responsible for safeguarding your private keys, seed phrases, and wallet access.
nonCustodialNature.keyRecovery: • Key Recovery: You can export your private keys from https://home.privy.io. Use the same login method you used on OrbCast. Privy is a trusted third-party wallet provider that we use to create your wallet.
nonCustodialNature.acknowledgmentOfRisk: • Acknowledgment of Risk: ORBCAST cannot recover, reverse, or restore any assets, positions, or transactions. All blockchain transactions are final and irreversible.

twoBalanceSystem.heading: 4. Wallet and Unified Trade Balance
twoBalanceSystem.body: The Interface shows your Wallet Balance on Arbitrum and your unified Trade Balance on Hyperliquid.
twoBalanceSystem.walletBalance: • Wallet Balance: On Arbitrum, used for deposits and withdrawals to external wallets.
twoBalanceSystem.tradeBalance: • Unified Trade Balance: USDC on Hyperliquid L1 used as collateral to buy and sell outcome tokens.
twoBalanceSystem.finalBody: Moving funds between balances requires on-chain transactions. You acknowledge that moving from Trade Balance to Wallet Balance incurs a 1 USDC fee (L1 to L2 Bridge Fee).

eligibilityAccountSecurity.heading: 5. Eligibility & Account Security
eligibilityAccountSecurity.body: You warrant that you are of legal age (18+ or your jurisdiction's age of majority) to use the Interface. You are responsible for all activities under your wallet and must immediately notify support@orbcast.xyz of any unauthorized use.

feeStructure.heading: 6. Fee Structure
feeStructure.body: You agree to pay applicable fees for using the Interface. Exact amounts are shown in the app before you confirm each transaction.
feeStructure.disclosure: • Fees: ORBCAST does not add extra fees beyond what the Interface displays. Trading, bridge, deposit, and withdrawal costs are set by Hyperliquid or other protocol/third-party providers.
feeStructure.finalBody: A fee may apply when you sell or a position settles, as shown in the fee schedule. Rewards can lower that fee.

tradingRisks.heading: 7. Trading Risks
tradingRisks.highRiskActivity: • High-Risk Activity: Prediction markets are speculative. You can lose some or all of the USDC you commit to a position.
tradingRisks.settlementRisk: • Settlement: Markets expire and settle according to the Hyperliquid protocol. If your side is not the winning outcome, those tokens can go to zero.
tradingRisks.noLeverage: • No Leverage: This Interface does not offer leveraged perpetual futures. Outcome contracts are fully collateralized; you are not liquidated on a margin ratio the way perps are.
tradingRisks.noAdvice: • No Advice: Nothing in the Interface constitutes financial, legal, or tax advice. You are solely responsible for your trading decisions.

marketSpecificFeatures.heading: 8. Market-Specific Features & Limitations
marketSpecificFeatures.body: The Interface displays data from decentralized protocols which may have the following features:
marketSpecificFeatures.settlement: • Settlement: Outcome markets have an expiry and a protocol-defined settlement. Prices can move quickly into that event.
marketSpecificFeatures.books: • Order Books: You trade against a book. Thin books can mean slippage or unfilled orders.
marketSpecificFeatures.finalBody: You accept that these features are governed by the protocol, not the Interface.

thirdPartyServices.heading: 9. Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.body: The Interface integrates third-party services beyond our control:
thirdPartyServices.moonpay: • MoonPay: Fiat-to-crypto purchases (requires KYC, subject to MoonPay's terms)
thirdPartyServices.arbitrum: • Arbitrum: Layer 2 blockchain for USDC deposits/withdrawals
thirdPartyServices.hyperliquidProtocol: • Hyperliquid Protocol: Underlying venue and settlement layer for HIP-4 outcome markets
thirdPartyServices.finalBody: You acknowledge that ORBCAST is not responsible for failures, inaccuracies, or changes to these services. Use of third-party services is subject to their respective terms.

depositsWithdrawalsTransfers.heading: 10. Deposits, Withdrawals & Transfers
depositsWithdrawalsTransfers.supportedAsset: • Supported Asset: USDC (USD Coin) on Arbitrum network only.
depositsWithdrawalsTransfers.depositMethods: • Deposit Methods: Direct USDC transfer to your wallet address or purchase via Moonpay.
depositsWithdrawalsTransfers.withdrawal: • Withdrawal: You can withdraw to any valid Arbitrum-compatible address (MetaMask, Binance, etc.). Withdrawals typically complete in 2-4 minutes but are subject to network conditions.
depositsWithdrawalsTransfers.irreversibility: • Irreversibility: All blockchain transactions are final. Sending to incorrect addresses results in permanent loss of funds.
depositsWithdrawalsTransfers.noReversals: • No Reversals: ORBCAST cannot reverse, cancel, or recover incorrectly sent transactions.

oneTapTradingAuthorizations.heading: 11. One-Tap Trading & Authorizations
oneTapTradingAuthorizations.body: By using the embedded Privy wallet session keys (one-tap trading feature), you authorize ORBCAST to execute trades on your behalf without requiring individual transaction approvals. You understand this convenience comes with responsibility to secure your device and account access.

protocolDependencyTechnicalRisks.heading: 12. Protocol Dependency & Technical Risks
protocolDependencyTechnicalRisks.body: The Interface's functionality depends entirely on external infrastructure:
protocolDependencyTechnicalRisks.smartContractRisk: • Smart Contract Risk: Bugs or exploits in Hyperliquid smart contracts could result in loss of funds.
protocolDependencyTechnicalRisks.networkCongestion: • Network Congestion: High blockchain traffic may delay or prevent transactions.
protocolDependencyTechnicalRisks.oracleFailure: • Oracle / Settlement Data: Inaccurate protocol or oracle data could affect execution prices or settlement.
protocolDependencyTechnicalRisks.bridgeRisk: • L1/L2 Bridge Risk: Cross-chain transfers involve technical risk.
protocolDependencyTechnicalRisks.finalBody: ORBCAST is not liable for any losses resulting from protocol-level issues, network failures, or smart contract vulnerabilities.

prohibitedUse.heading: 13. Prohibited Use
prohibitedUse.restrictedJurisdictions: • Use the Interface from jurisdictions where such services are prohibited
prohibitedUse.marketManipulation: • Engage in market manipulation, wash trading, or other fraudulent activities
prohibitedUse.exploitBugs: • Attempt to exploit bugs or vulnerabilities for financial gain
prohibitedUse.moneyLaundering: • Use the Interface for money laundering or terrorist financing
prohibitedUse.violateLaws: • Violate any applicable laws or regulations
prohibitedUse.finalBody: We reserve the right to restrict access at our discretion for any violation.

limitationOfLiability.heading: 14. Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.body: TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, THE COMPANY SHALL NOT BE LIABLE FOR:
limitationOfLiability.tradingLosses: • Trading losses, including losing sides of prediction markets
limitationOfLiability.userError: • Loss of funds due to user error or lost keys
limitationOfLiability.oracleFailure: • Inaccurate price or settlement data from Hyperliquid or other third-party oracles
limitationOfLiability.indirectDamages: • Any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages
limitationOfLiability.finalBody: THE INTERFACE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND.

indemnification.heading: 15. Indemnification
indemnification.body: You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless ORBCAST, its affiliates, officers, directors, employees, and agents from any claims, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, or expenses (including legal fees) arising from:
indemnification.violationLaw: • Your violation of any law or third-party rights

modificationsTermination.heading: 16. Modifications & Termination
modificationsTermination.body: We may modify these Terms at any time by updating the "Last Updated" date. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance. We may suspend, restrict, or terminate your access for any breach or at our discretion without notice.

governingLawDisputeResolution.heading: 17. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
governingLawDisputeResolution.body: These Terms shall be governed by the laws of the State of Wyoming, USA. Any disputes shall be resolved through binding arbitration in Cheyenne, Wyoming, and you waive your right to a jury trial.

severabilityEntireAgreement.heading: 18. Severability & Entire Agreement
severabilityEntireAgreement.body: If any provision is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain in effect. These Terms, together with our Privacy Policy, constitute the entire agreement between you and ORBCAST.

reverseSolicitationEU.heading: 19. No Solicitation (European Union)
reverseSolicitationEU.body: ORBCAST does not target or solicit users in the European Union (EU). Access by users in the EU is at the user's 'exclusive initiative' (Reverse Solicitation). By using the Interface, you acknowledge that you have not been prompted to use the service via any marketing or advertising directed at the EU.
